name: sne.space WebMCP
description: Web Model Context Protocol (WebMCP) and Agentic Resource Discovery manifest for the Open Supernova Catalog (sne.space). Provides structured tools for AI agents over 110,000+ supernovae from 1000 AD to 2026+.

tools.name: search_supernovae
tools.description: Search 110,000+ supernovae and transients by IAU designation, name, or survey alias (e.g. SN 2023ixf, SN 1987A, SN 2011fe, AT2024nrb).

query.description: Supernova designation, IAU name, or survey alias

tools.name: get_supernova
tools.description: Retrieve complete astrophysical dossier for a supernova, including classification, redshift, coordinates, host galaxy, discovery date, peak magnitude, and bibliography.

name.description: Supernova name or IAU designation (e.g. SN 2023ixf, SN 1987A, SN 2011fe)

tools.name: search_by_coordinates
tools.description: Cone search for supernovae and transients within an angular radius around J2000 celestial coordinates (Right Ascension and Declination in decimal degrees).

ra.description: Right Ascension in decimal degrees (0.0 to 360.0)

tools.name: search_by_type
tools.description: Find supernovae matching a specific astrophysical classification type (e.g. 'Ia', 'II-P', 'IIn', 'SLSN-I', 'Ia-91T', 'TDE').

type.description: Astrophysical classification type (e.g. Ia, II-P, IIn, SLSN)

tools.name: get_recent_discoveries
tools.description: Fetch latest discovered supernovae and active transient alerts from the last 30 days, sorted by discovery date.

limit.description: Maximum number of recent transients to return (default: 25)

tools.name: get_photometry
tools.description: Retrieve calibrated multi-band photometric light curve observations (time, magnitude, error, filter band, telescope/observer) for a supernova.

name.description: Supernova name or IAU designation (e.g. SN 2023ixf, SN 2011fe)

tools.name: get_spectra
tools.description: Retrieve calibrated 1D optical spectra (wavelength in Angstroms, flux, epoch/phase, instrument) for a supernova.

name.description: Supernova name or IAU designation (e.g. SN 2023ixf, SN 1987A)
